weeks.summary: Week 1 — Foundation. Learn the movements, own full range of motion, build a base. Everything deliberately submaximal — leave ~3 reps in the tank. Shoulders and neck ridiculously light on purpose.

exercises.name: Mobility warm-up
exercises.reps: 5 min: shoulder circles (CARs), band/towel external rotations 2x15, scapular push-ups 2x10, wrist prep
exercises.notes: Do this BEFORE the session — don't skip it.

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
exercises.reps: feet on a low step (~20cm), 8-10 reps
exercises.notes: Chest to floor, controlled. This is your #1 mover — full range every rep.

exercises.name: DB Floor/Incline Press
exercises.notes: Floor press early = shoulder-friendly. Press with control, no bouncing.

exercises.name: Ring/Parallel Dip Progression
exercises.reps: 3 sets: support hold at top 20-30s + 3 slow negatives (5s lower). NO full dips.
exercises.notes: Shoulders lead here. Sharp/pinchy pain = stop and back off, that's not a push-through. Muscle burn is fine. Never bounce out of the bottom.

exercises.name: Pike Push-up (light shoulders)
exercises.notes: Eased-in overhead work. Keep range pain-free; stop short of any impingement.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (DB or ring)
exercises.notes: Full lockout, controlled.

exercises.name: Neck — Flexion/Extension
exercises.reps: 2 sets x 10 slow flexion + 10 extension (hand/towel resistance, very light)
exercises.notes: Neck ramps SLOW — it's easy to tweak. Light pressure, smooth reps, never jerky. Builds the thickness you're after over months, not weeks.

exercises.name: Cool-down / stretch
exercises.reps: Doorway pec stretch 2x30s per side, cross-body shoulder stretch, child's pose
exercises.notes: Do this AFTER — 5 min, breathe into the stretches.

exercises.name: Easy Run
exercises.reps: 30 min @ conversational pace (can hold a sentence)
exercises.notes: Truly easy. This builds the aerobic engine without stealing recovery from lifting.

exercises.name: Mobility warm-up
exercises.reps: 5 min: dead hang 2x20s, thoracic extensions, scap pulls 2x8, band pull-aparts 2x15
exercises.notes: Do this BEFORE the session — don't skip it.

exercises.name: Pull-up (full ROM)
exercises.reps: 3 sets of 5-6 full reps (chin over bar), leave 3 in reserve
exercises.notes: Dead hang start, pull the elbows down and back, chin clears the bar. Quality over quantity.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.notes: Lower your feet / walk them forward to make it harder. Big posture + upper-back builder for desk shoulders.

exercises.name: Chin-up (biceps emphasis)
exercises.notes: Supinated grip. This plus curls is your bicep fix — and the reason your pull-ups will finish at the top.

exercises.name: DB Biceps Curl
exercises.notes: Slow negative. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Mudgar Swings (10-to-2 / 360s)
exercises.notes: Grip + forearm + shoulder health. Start slow and controlled with the 7kg.

exercises.name: Dead Hang / Wrist Curl
exercises.notes: Direct forearm thickness work.

exercises.name: Cool-down / stretch
exercises.reps: Lat stretch 2x30s per side, forearm/wrist stretch, thread-the-needle t-spine
exercises.notes: Do this AFTER — 5 min, breathe into the stretches.

exercises.name: Mobility warm-up
exercises.reps: 6 min: hip CARs, ankle rocks, couch/hip-flexor stretch 2x30s (desk hips!), glute bridges 2x12
exercises.notes: Do this BEFORE the session — don't skip it.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge at the hips, flat back, feel the hamstrings load. Posterior chain is your #1 gap.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Rear foot on the chair. Single-leg strength + stability — huge for desk-weak legs.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl Progression
exercises.reps: 5-8 controlled reps (assist with hands as needed)
exercises.notes: Hook feet under something solid. Lower as slow as you can — negatives build the hamstring.

exercises.name: Single-leg Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.notes: Knees just off the floor, flat back. Full-body + core + gentle shoulder loading.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: The abs you hate. Controlled, no swinging.

exercises.name: Cool-down / stretch
exercises.reps: Hamstring + hip-flexor stretch 2x30s each, figure-4 glute stretch
exercises.notes: Do this AFTER — 5 min, breathe into the stretches.

exercises.name: Steady Segment
exercises.reps: 9 min @ comfortably-hard (can speak a few words)
exercises.notes: Your one 'quality' run. Don't turn it into a race.

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.notes: Smooth, fast feet, not a sprint.

exercises.name: Mobility warm-up
exercises.reps: 5 min: full-body flow — arm swings, hip openers, t-spine rotations, scap push-ups
exercises.notes: Do this BEFORE the session — don't skip it.

exercises.name: Decline Push-up (2nd chest hit)
exercises.reps: feet on a low step (~20cm), 8-10 reps
exercises.notes: Second weekly upper-chest session — this frequency is what grows it. Chest to floor, controlled. This is your #1 mover — full range every rep.

exercises.name: Archer / Ring Row
exercises.notes: Second back hit — lean toward the working side for more load.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise (light)
exercises.notes: Shoulder WIDTH, but strict and light — no swinging, stop if it pinches.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Grip, traps, neck, core all at once. Stand tall, brace.

exercises.name: Neck — Lateral + Iso
exercises.reps: 2 sets x 10 slow flexion + 10 extension (hand/towel resistance, very light)
exercises.notes: Neck ramps SLOW — it's easy to tweak. Light pressure, smooth reps, never jerky. Builds the thickness you're after over months, not weeks.

exercises.name: Mudgar 360s
exercises.notes: More forearm + shoulder-health volume.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Low back pressed into the floor the whole time.

exercises.name: Cool-down / stretch
exercises.reps: Full-body stretch: pecs, lats, hips, neck. 6-8 min, unwind.
exercises.notes: Do this AFTER — 5 min, breathe into the stretches.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine
exercises.reps: Foam roll / extensions + open-book rotations 2x10 per side
exercises.notes: Undo the desk hunch. Priority for you.

exercises.name: Hip Openers
exercises.notes: Desk hips get tight — this keeps your squats and runs healthy.

exercises.name: Neck & Upper Back
exercises.reps: Gentle neck CARs, chin tucks 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15
exercises.notes: Posture reset for the office-worker rounding.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.notes: Blood flow, recovery, no intensity.

weeks.summary: Week 5 — Peak volume. Highest, hardest week: take working sets to or near failure, drop sets on chest and back, slow negatives everywhere. The grind week — recovery and sleep matter most here.

exercises.name: Mobility warm-up

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
exercises.reps: feet on a chair (~45cm), 10-12 reps + 1 drop set to floor

exercises.name: DB Floor/Incline Press

exercises.name: Ring/Parallel Dip Progression
